g.text: Positive = more phrase occurrences; not a quality score.
Retained 95% episode-bootstrap intervals are descriptive; seeds cluster within episodes. Shared synthetic stories are reused across models.
S-015 uses each model’s own reviewed memories. Available pairs can differ by model; missing pairs are never zero.
S-014/S-015 show semantic verdict scores; strict-format compliance and adjudications are separate in the source report.
No execution or private-state claim. Units and directions differ across panels; no model-superiority test is shown.
